title: About NIAZ NET | International Business Development
description: Learn about NIAZ NET, its international business development approach, strategic sourcing, distribution, trade and partnership services.
headings: Our Role in the Value Chain
paragraphs: Since 1997, NIAZ NET has connected manufacturers, suppliers, brands and buyers across pharmaceutical, healthcare, nutrition and related industries. Our network includes more than 2,700 wholesalers and distributors, and we have introduced over 5,000 products to regional and international markets.
Access to high quality products from trusted manufacturers worldwide.
Get exclusive rights for brands and products in your target markets.
Advanced technologies and know-how for local manufacturing.
Build, grow and manage powerful brands in new and existing markets.
Full support in registration, compliance and regulatory affairs.
Strategic support to enter and grow in new and emerging markets.
Develop your own brand with our end-to-end solutions.
Build long-term partnerships and licensing opportunities for mutual growth.
Our commercial network and target markets extend across seven key regions.

NIAZ NET works at the intersection of international trade, pharmaceutical and healthcare industries, nutrition and business development. We identify commercial opportunities, connect the right parties and coordinate the steps needed to move qualified opportunities forward.
Four focused business pathways — one connected international network.
Connecting international brands and technology owners with suitable Iranian manufacturers for local production, contract manufacturing and long-term industrial cooperation.
Introducing qualified Iranian-made products to international wholesalers, distributors and commercial partners, and supporting export-market development.
Sourcing pharmaceutical APIs, excipients and specialized raw materials from qualified suppliers in China, India and other markets for the Iranian market.
Developing international market opportunities for Iranian pharmaceutical, healthcare, nutrition products and selected raw materials.
Our activities focus on products and services within the following related fields.
A clear, coordinated process that connects commercial objectives with qualified partners and practical next steps.
Assess product requirements, target markets, commercial objectives and partner capabilities.
Identify and introduce relevant manufacturers, suppliers, brands, wholesalers and distributors.
Support commercial discussions, sourcing, market entry and cooperation planning.
Build a practical path for sustainable trade and long-term business relationships.
To connect reliable businesses and products with the right markets through transparent communication, practical coordination and long-term commercial relationships.
To be a trusted international business-development and trade partner linking manufacturers, brands, suppliers and distributors across regional and global markets.
Integrity, reliability, market knowledge, accountability, responsive communication and sustainable partnerships.
If you are a manufacturer, supplier, brand owner, wholesaler or distributor seeking a reliable route into a new market, NIAZ NET is ready to explore the opportunity with you.

title: Import & Export Markets: Iran, Türkiye & Beyond | NIAZ NET
headings: Import & Export Markets: Iran, Türkiye & Beyond
paragraphs: We coordinate cross-border business enquiries involving pharmaceutical products, APIs, healthcare products and related sectors. Each opportunity is assessed by product, origin, destination, counterparties and applicable legal or regulatory requirements.

Trade and distribution enquiries involving Iran may require careful review of product eligibility, local registration, import/export permissions, payment arrangements and the responsibilities of all parties. We help organize the commercial questions and document requests for each eligible opportunity.

Türkiye can be a relevant point for supplier discussions, distribution planning and regional business coordination. The fit of each opportunity depends on the product category, manufacturer, destination market and agreed commercial route.

Requirements differ across Middle Eastern countries and between medicines, APIs, medical devices, nutrition products and other goods. Product registration, labeling, local representation and import permissions should be checked country by country before any market launch or shipment.

Opportunities involving Spain and other European markets can require product-specific assessment, partner qualification, documentation review and careful checks of relevant trade and regulatory rules. This page does not imply a registered office or authorized representation in every European country.

Manufacturer and supplier enquiries involving China or India should be assessed on specification, manufacturing capability, available quality documents, order conditions and destination-market requirements. Supplier qualification and technical acceptance remain the buyer’s responsibility.

NIAZ NET coordinates commercial enquiries for pharmaceutical finished products, active pharmaceutical ingredients, medical devices, brand registration, exclusive agency, technology transfer, contract manufacturing and supply-chain follow-up.

Geographic references describe markets of interest for commercial enquiries; they are not a claim of a local office, guaranteed distribution capability or regulatory authorization in every listed jurisdiction. Availability, legality and transaction feasibility must be confirmed for each product and destination.

title: Pharmaceutical & Product Brand Registration | NIAZ NET
headings: Information to include in an enquiry
paragraphs: Coordinate brand registration and market-entry planning for pharmaceutical, healthcare, nutrition, cosmetics and other regulated product brands, subject to local rules.

Niaz Net Tehran supports brand owners and business partners through the commercial planning and coordination required to introduce a brand into a target market. We help clarify market objectives, identify the appropriate local route, and coordinate discussions with relevant commercial and regulatory stakeholders.

From initial assessment to follow-up with partners and documentation teams, our role is to keep the process organized, transparent, and aligned with the brand owner’s goals. Registration requirements and approval timelines depend on the product category and the competent authorities in each market.

We clarify the product category, brand ownership, target markets and the intended route to market. Where needed, we help organize discussions among brand owners, potential representatives and qualified local regulatory specialists.

Regulatory approvals, import eligibility, quality acceptance, licensing and transaction feasibility must be confirmed for each product and destination market by the responsible parties and qualified professionals. NIAZ NET coordinates commercial communication; it does not replace regulatory authorities, legal advisers or independent quality assessment.
Send us the product or project details, target market and the type of support required. Our team can review the initial scope and identify the information needed for a useful commercial discussion.

Target country, preferred commercial channel and desired launch scope.
Available product dossier, current registrations and brand or distribution authorization documents.
